preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case contains an integer n between 2 and 3 * 10^5 inclusive.
The sum of all n over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(sequence) == n for n, sequence in zip(test_cases, sequences))
postconditions.description: Each output sequence has the same length as the corresponding input n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(sequence)) == n for n, sequence in zip(test_cases, sequences))
postconditions.description: Each output sequence contains distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= 10**9 for a in sequence) for sequence in sequences)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output sequences is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(max(sequence) - min(sequence) == (sum(sequence))**0.5 for sequence in sequences)
postconditions.description: For each sequence, the difference between the maximum and minimum values equals the square root of the sum of the sequence.
